findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: minimal-site-studio, x402-endpoint-check · Private data: audit-terms, marketplace-skill-creator, x402-paid-api-builder, agent-full-backup, json-to-md, json-canonicalize, markdown-lint, env-parse, csv-convert, csv-drift, toml-parse · Public sink: marketplace-skill-creator, mcp-update-kit, mcp-registry-update-kit, csv-drift, dst-state · Destructive: marketplace-skill-creator, mcp-update-kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: minimal-site-studio, x402-endpoint-check · Private data: audit-terms, marketplace-skill-creator, x402-paid-api-builder, agent-full-backup, json-to-md, json-canonicalize, markdown-lint, env-parse, csv-convert, csv-drift, toml-parse · Public sink: marketplace-skill-creator, mcp-update-kit, mcp-registry-update-kit, csv-drift, dst-state · Destructive: marketplace-skill-creator, mcp-update-kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
